o.text: Borrowed from Russian ано́нс (anóns), ultimately from French annonce.
From qazanılmış (“acquired”) + immun çatışmazlığı (“immune deficiency”) + sindrom (“syndrome”). Calque from English.
Borrowed from Russian увертю́ра (uvertjúra), from French ouverture.
